notes.title: "The Garden of Hermeneus" is now available!
notes.notes: [p]We've just released The Garden of Hermeneus![/p][p]Step into the shoes of "Me," a linguist, and decipher the language of "Him," a beastman held in a cage. What are "His" thoughts, and what hidden truth lies behind their war?[/p][p]The Steam version supports both controller and keyboard input for text entry.[/p][p]To celebrate the launch, we're holding a two-week sale, so don't miss this chance to embark on a life with "Him."[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545202/f81c337ccf58a1ee9a00d5603dee2e45ed697b79.png"][/img][/p]
